speaker: mission_control
english: Probe, get ready for the burn.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, ya lo vemos. Espera a la marca.
english: Yes, we see it. Wait for the mark.

speaker: mission_control
english: Burn coming up. Point it right.

speaker: mission_control
english: HECS, the burn is coming up.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Un descenso digno de la realeza.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Es un paracaídas, no una cometa.
english: It's a parachute, not a kite.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Acoplamiento perfecto, Okto. No te lo creas mucho.
english: Perfect docking, Okto. Don't let it go to your head.

speaker: mission_control
english: We're still here. Hang in there.

speaker: mission_control
english: Easy, probe. We're still with you.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquilo, HECS. Era una sola pieza.
english: Easy, HECS. It was one part.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquilo, chico. Solo era una pieza.
english: Easy, boy. It was just a part.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Hay un nodo nuevo en el mapa.
english: There's a new node on the map.

speaker: mission_control
english: Probe, we have a new plan.

speaker: mission_control
english: Node ready. We'll warn you before.

speaker: mission_control
english: HECS, new node. Take a deep breath.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, revisa este nodo, por favor.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, no podemos ir hacia la piedra.
english: No, we can't go towards the rock.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Su excelencia, hemos preparado una ruta.
english: Your excellency, we prepared a route.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: El plan de maniobra, como pidió.
english: The burn plan, as you asked.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Stayputnik, tenemos un plan de maniobra.
english: Stayputnik, we have a burn plan.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Un nodo nuevo. No te preocupes, es fácil.
english: A new node. Don't worry, it's easy.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Batería baja. Hora de la siesta, sonda.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Tranquilo, HECS. Hora de la siesta.

speaker: mission_control
english: Okto, your battery is running out.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Échate, Rovemate. Hora de la siesta.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Lo siento, su excelencia. Hora de la siesta.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buenos días. No te has perdido nada.
english: Good morning. You didn't miss a thing.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Buenos días, Okto. Sí, estabas dormido.
english: Good morning, Okto. Yes, you were asleep.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sonda, esto va directo al laboratorio.
english: Probe, this goes straight to the lab.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Datos nuevos. No sabemos qué son, pero son nuevos.
english: New data. No idea what it is, but it's new.

speaker: mission_control
english: Just a normal probe, doing science.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Eres mi favorita. No se lo digas a las demás.
english: You're my favorite. Don't tell the others.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Datos recibidos, HECS. El laboratorio ya tiene {sci_total} puntos.
english: Got the data, HECS. The lab is at {sci_total} points now.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, has enviado el informe tres veces.
english: HECS, you sent the report three times.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, ¿le has puesto notas a un termómetro?
english: HECS, did you add footnotes to a thermometer?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Gran medida, Okto. {sci_total} puntos de ciencia en el laboratorio.
english: Great measurement, Okto. {sci_total} science points in the lab.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Okto, ¿has hecho la ciencia o la has corregido?
english: Okto, did you do the science or correct it?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Estos datos son demasiado buenos, Okto.
english: This data is too good, Okto.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: ¿Has hecho ciencia o te has tumbado encima?
english: Did you do science, or just lie on it?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Creo que fue sin querer. Pero cuenta.
english: I think it was an accident. But it counts.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Gracias por los datos, su excelencia.
english: Thank you for the data, your excellency.

speaker: mission_control
english: Are you charging us for the data, your excellency?

speaker: mission_control
english: Stayputnik, how did you even measure that?

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Recibido, Stayputnik. Ya son {sci_total} puntos de ciencia.
english: Got it, Stayputnik. That makes {sci_total} science points.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Rovemate, no es hora del baño.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Ahí estás. Sí, te hemos echado de menos.
english: There you are. Yes, we missed you.

speaker: mission_control
english: Easy, HECS, that was the stage.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: No, Rovemate, no puedes ir a buscarla.
english: No, Rovemate, you can't fetch it.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Su excelencia ya no necesitaba esa etapa.
english: Your excellency no longer needed that stage.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, Stayputnik, esa pieza no vuelve.
english: Yes, Stayputnik, that piece isn't coming back.

speaker: mission_control
english: It counts. We're still in one piece.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: HECS, has aterrizado. Puedes dejar de temblar.
english: HECS, you landed. You can stop shaking.

speaker: mission_control
english: Yes, that's it. We stop here.

speaker: mission_control
english: We cut it on purpose, HECS.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Sí, Okto, eso es todo lo que tiene.
english: Yes, Okto, that's all it has.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {probe}, la lectura eléctrica necesita atención antes de la próxima tarea.
english: {probe}, the power reading needs attention before the next task.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Da prioridad a los sistemas esenciales sobre los pitidos opcionales, {probe}.
english: Keep the essential systems ahead of the optional beeps, {probe}.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: La mesa de energía está comparando las lecturas que se recuperan, {probe}.
english: The power desk is comparing the recovering readings, {probe}.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {probe}, vuelve a poner el equipo en servicio una comprobación cada vez.
english: {probe}, return the equipment to service one check at a time.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: La radio te ha vuelto a encontrar, {probe}. Estamos revisando el registro.
english: The radio has found you again, {probe}. We are checking the log.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {probe}, tu señal ha mejorado el humor de quien lleva el receptor.
english: {probe}, your signal has put the receiver operator in a better mood.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Estamos revisando la nueva trayectoria antes del próximo encendido, {probe}.
english: We are reviewing the new path before the next burn, {probe}.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {probe}, la página de maniobra está lista para una revisión cuidadosa.
english: {probe}, the maneuver page is ready for a careful review.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Da prioridad al encendido previsto sobre los pitidos de celebración, {probe}.
english: Keep the planned burn ahead of the celebratory beeping, {probe}.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: {probe}, la próxima cita del motor se acerca.
english: {probe}, the next engine appointment is getting close.
